-- Command protocol of checkpoint two: base tables with private row IDs,
-- atomic change batches, and named incrementally maintained views.
import Json (..)
import Model (..)
import Parser (..)
import Binder (..)
import Engine (..)
import Views (..)
import Data.List (..)
import Data.Map (..)
import Data.Foldable (all, any, length)

-- A base table: rows by private ID, rows by sequence number (the encounter
-- order the views see: initial rows 1..N, later inserts appended), the IDs
-- ever used, and the next sequence number.
pub type Base = Base {
  table: Table,
  by_id: Map(Int, (Int, List(Json))),
  by_seq: Map(Int, List(Json)),
  used: Map(Int, Unit),
  next_seq: Int
}

pub type Db = Db { tables: List(Base), views: Map(String, View), revision: Int }

fn base_of(t : Table) : Base =
  var by_id := map_empty
  var by_seq := map_empty
  var used := map_empty
  var n := 0
  for row in sof(t.rows) do
    n += 1
    by_id := map_insert(n, (n, row), by_id)
    by_seq := map_insert(n, row, by_seq)
    used := map_insert(n, (), used)
  Base {
    table = Table { ..t, rows = [] },
    by_id = by_id,
    by_seq = by_seq,
    used = used,
    next_seq = n + 1
  }

pub fn db_of(database : List(Table)) : Db =
  Db { tables = map(base_of, database), views = map_empty, revision = 0 }

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- shapes
fn lower(c : Int) : Bool = c >= 97 && c <= 122

fn view_name_ok(s : String) : Bool =
  let n = byte_len(s)
  n >= 1
    && n <= 40
    && lower(byte_at(s, 0))
    && all(
        \(i) -> lower(byte_at(s, i)) || digit(byte_at(s, i)) || byte_at(s, i) == 45,
        range(1, n),
      )

fn table_name_ok(s : String) : Bool =
  byte_len(s) > 0
    && letter(byte_at(s, 0))
    && all(\(i) -> letter(byte_at(s, i)) || digit(byte_at(s, i)), range(0, byte_len(s)))

fn has_fields(j : Json, names : List(String)) : Bool =
  match j of
    JObj(xs) =>
      length(xs) == length(names)
        && all(\(name) -> length(filter(\(kv) -> fst(kv) == name, xs)) == 1, names)
    _ => false

fn bad() : Unit = reject("INVALID_COMMAND")

fn op_of(c : Json) : String =
  match c of
    JObj(xs) =>
      match filter(\(kv) -> fst(kv) == "op", xs) of
        Cons((_, JStr(s)), Nil) => s
        _ =>
          bad()
          ""
    _ =>
      bad()
      ""

fn str_field(c : Json, key : String) : String =
  match getfield(c, key) of
    JStr(s) => s
    _ =>
      bad()
      ""

fn validate_change(ch : Json) : Unit =
  let op = op_of(ch)
  if op == "insert" || op == "update" then
    demand(has_fields(ch, ["op", "table", "id", "row"]), "INVALID_COMMAND")
    match getfield(ch, "row") of
      JArr(_) => ()
      _ => bad()
  elif op == "delete" then
    demand(has_fields(ch, ["op", "table", "id"]), "INVALID_COMMAND")
  else
    bad()
  demand(table_name_ok(str_field(ch, "table")), "INVALID_COMMAND")
  match getfield(ch, "id") of
    JInt(n) => demand(n >= 1 && n <= 2147483647, "INVALID_COMMAND")
    _ => bad()

fn validate_command(c : Json) : Unit =
  let op = op_of(c)
  if op == "create" then
    demand(has_fields(c, ["op", "view", "sql", "optimize"]), "INVALID_COMMAND")
    demand(view_name_ok(str_field(c, "view")), "INVALID_COMMAND")
    let ignored = str_field(c, "sql")
    match getfield(c, "optimize") of
      JBool(_) => ()
      _ => bad()
  elif op == "read" || op == "drop" then
    demand(has_fields(c, ["op", "view"]), "INVALID_COMMAND")
    demand(view_name_ok(str_field(c, "view")), "INVALID_COMMAND")
  elif op == "apply" then
    demand(has_fields(c, ["op", "changes"]), "INVALID_COMMAND")
    match getfield(c, "changes") of
      JArr(cs) =>
        demand(length(cs) >= 1 && length(cs) <= 200, "INVALID_COMMAND")
        for ch in sof(cs) do
          validate_change(ch)
      _ => bad()
  else
    bad()

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- batches
fn validate_row(t : Table, j : Json) : List(Json) =
  let row = arr(j)
  demand(length(row) == length(t.columns), "INVALID_ROW")
  for i in srange(0, length(row)) do
    let c = at(t.columns, i)
    let v = at(row, i)
    demand(value_type(v) == c.kind || is_null(v) && c.nullable, "INVALID_ROW")
    match v of
      JInt(n) => demand(n >= -1000000000 && n <= 1000000000, "INVALID_ROW")
      _ => ()
  row

fn base_rows(b : Base) : List((Int, List(Json))) = map_to_list(b.by_seq)

fn find_base(tables : List(Base), name : String) : Int =
  match position(\(b : Base) -> b.table.name == name, tables) of
    Some(i) => i
    None =>
      reject("UNKNOWN_TABLE")
      -1

-- Every change is applied to a private copy of the tables; a rejection leaves
-- the caller's database untouched. The per-table event maps net out repeated
-- changes to one row, so each view sees the batch's final state once.
pub fn apply_batch(db : Db, changes : List(Json)) : Db =
  var tables := db.tables
  var deltas := map(\(_) -> map_empty, db.tables)
  for ch in sof(changes) do
    let op = text(getfield(ch, "op"))
    let ti = find_base(tables, text(getfield(ch, "table")))
    var b : Base := at(tables, ti)
    let id = integer(getfield(ch, "id"))
    var ev := at(deltas, ti)
    if op == "delete" then
      match map_lookup(id, b.by_id) of
        Some((seq, old)) =>
          tables := list_set(
              tables,
              ti,
              Base { ..b, by_id = map_delete(id, b.by_id), by_seq = map_delete(seq, b.by_seq) },
            )
          ev := ev_remove(ev, seq, old)
        None => reject("UNKNOWN_ROW")
    else
      let row = validate_row(b.table, getfield(ch, "row"))
      if op == "insert" then
        demand(not(map_member(id, b.used)), "ROW_ID_USED")
        let seq = b.next_seq
        tables := list_set(
            tables,
            ti,
            Base {
              ..b,
              by_id = map_insert(id, (seq, row), b.by_id),
              by_seq = map_insert(seq, row, b.by_seq),
              used = map_insert(id, (), b.used),
              next_seq = seq + 1
            },
          )
        ev := ev_add(ev, seq, row)
      else
        match map_lookup(id, b.by_id) of
          Some((seq, old)) =>
            tables := list_set(
                tables,
                ti,
                Base { ..b, by_id = map_insert(id, (seq, row), b.by_id), by_seq = map_insert(seq, row, b.by_seq) },
              )
            ev := ev_add(ev_remove(ev, seq, old), seq, row)
          None => reject("UNKNOWN_ROW")
    deltas := list_set(deltas, ti, ev)
  var views := db.views
  for nv in sof(map_to_list(db.views)) do
    let (name, view) = nv
    var v : View := view
    for i in srange(0, length(v.sources)) do
      let (rem, add) = ev_lists(at(deltas, at(v.sources, i)))
      if length(rem) > 0 || length(add) > 0 then
        v := apply_source(v, i, rem, add)
    views := map_insert(name, v, views)
  Db { tables = tables, views = views, revision = db.revision + 1 }

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- commands
fn ok_reply(value : Json) : Json = JObj([("ok", JBool(true)), ("result", value)])

fn error_reply(code : String) : Json =
  JObj([("ok", JBool(false)), ("error", JObj([("code", JStr(code))]))])

fn run_command(db : Db, c : Json) : (Json, Db) =
  validate_command(c)
  let op = text(getfield(c, "op"))
  if op == "create" then
    let name = text(getfield(c, "view"))
    demand(not(map_member(name, db.views)), "VIEW_EXISTS")
    let schema = map(\(b : Base) -> b.table, db.tables)
    let bound = bind(parse_sql(text(getfield(c, "sql"))), schema)
    let plan = if truth(getfield(c, "optimize")) then optimize(bound) else bound
    let sources = map(\(s) -> find_base(db.tables, fst(s)), plan.query.sources)
    let loads = map(\(ti : Int) -> base_rows(at(db.tables, ti)), sources)
    let v = create_view(plan, sources, loads)
    (
      ok_reply(JObj([("view", JStr(name)), ("revision", JInt(db.revision))])),
      Db { ..db, views = map_insert(name, v, db.views) },
    )
  elif op == "read" then
    match map_lookup(text(getfield(c, "view")), db.views) of
      Some(v) =>
        (
          ok_reply(JObj([
              ("revision", JInt(db.revision)),
              ("columns", JArr(view_columns(v))),
              ("rows", JArr(map(JArr, view_rows(v)))),
            ])),
          db,
        )
      None =>
        reject("UNKNOWN_VIEW")
        (JNull, db)
  elif op == "drop" then
    let name = text(getfield(c, "view"))
    demand(map_member(name, db.views), "UNKNOWN_VIEW")
    (ok_reply(JObj([("dropped", JStr(name))])), Db { ..db, views = map_delete(name, db.views) })
  else
    let next = apply_batch(db, arr(getfield(c, "changes")))
    (ok_reply(JObj([("revision", JInt(next.revision))])), next)

-- One reply per command; a failing command changes nothing and processing
-- continues with the state before it.
pub fn run_commands(db0 : Db, commands : List(Json)) : List(Json) =
  var db := db0
  var replies := []
  for c in sof(commands) do
    let current = db
    let (reply, next) =
      handle run_command(current, c) with
        never reject(code) => (error_reply(code), current)
        return r => r
    db := next
    replies := append(replies, [reply])
  replies

-- Relational evaluation preserves input encounter order through every operator.
-- Boolean results are three-valued: JBool(true), JBool(false), or JNull (UNKNOWN).
-- WHERE, HAVING, and ON keep a row only when the predicate is exactly TRUE.
import Json (..)
import Model (..)
import Binder (tree_any)
import Data.List (..)
import Data.Foldable (all, any, length, sum)

-- Compares two non-null values of the same type.
pub fn compare_value(a : Json, b : Json) : Int =
  match (a, b) of
    (JInt(x), JInt(y)) =>
      if x < y then
        -1
      elif x > y then
        1
      else
        0
    (JStr(x), JStr(y)) => str_cmp(x, y)
    (JBool(x), JBool(y)) =>
      if x == y then
        0
      elif x then
        1
      else
        -1
    _ => 0

fn is_false(j : Json) : Bool = not(is_null(j)) && not(truth(j))

fn first_non_null(vs : List(Json)) : Json =
  match vs of
    Nil => JNull
    Cons(v, rest) =>
      if is_null(v) then
        first_non_null(rest)
      else
        v

pub fn evaluate(e : Expr, row : List(Json), group : List(List(Json))) : Json =
  let op = e.op
  if op == "lit" then
    e.value
  elif op == "col" then
    at(row, e.index)
  elif agg(op) then
    if op == "COUNT" && length(e.args) == 0 then
      JInt(length(group))
    else
      -- Every aggregate other than COUNT(*) ignores NULL inputs.
      let vs = filter(\(v) -> not(is_null(v)), map(\(r) -> evaluate(at(e.args, 0), r, []), group))
      if op == "COUNT" then
        JInt(length(vs))
      elif length(vs) == 0 then
        JNull
      elif op == "SUM" then
        JInt(sum(map(integer, vs)))
      else
        extremum(vs, op == "MIN")
  elif op == "COALESCE" then
    first_non_null(map(\(a) -> evaluate(a, row, group), e.args))
  else
    let a = evaluate(at(e.args, 0), row, group)
    if op == "ISNULL" then
      JBool(is_null(a))
    elif op == "ISNOTNULL" then
      JBool(not(is_null(a)))
    elif op == "NOT" then
      if is_null(a) then
        JNull
      else
        JBool(not(truth(a)))
    else
      let b = evaluate(at(e.args, 1), row, group)
      if op == "AND" then
        if is_false(a) || is_false(b) then
          JBool(false)
        elif is_null(a) || is_null(b) then
          JNull
        else
          JBool(true)
      elif op == "OR" then
        if truth(a) || truth(b) then
          JBool(true)
        elif is_null(a) || is_null(b) then
          JNull
        else
          JBool(false)
      elif is_null(a) || is_null(b) then
        -- Arithmetic and ordinary comparison propagate NULL.
        JNull
      elif op == "+" then
        JInt(integer(a) + integer(b))
      elif op == "-" then
        JInt(integer(a) - integer(b))
      elif op == "*" then
        JInt(integer(a) * integer(b))
      else
        let c = compare_value(a, b)
        JBool(
            if op == "=" then c == 0 elif op == "<>" then c /= 0 elif op == "<" then c < 0 elif op == ">" then c > 0 elif op == "<=" then c <= 0 else c >= 0,
          )

fn extremum(vs : List(Json), minimum : Bool) : Json =
  match vs of
    Nil => JNull
    Cons(v, Nil) => v
    Cons(v, rest) =>
      let b = extremum(rest, minimum)
      if (compare_value(v, b) < 0) == minimum then
        v
      else
        b

-- Bottom-up simplification. Literal-only subtrees are evaluated with the same
-- three-valued semantics as execution, so NULL = NULL folds to NULL rather than
-- TRUE. IS [NOT] NULL and COALESCE are additionally simplified using the
-- nullability bound computed by the binder, which already includes the NULL
-- padding introduced by LEFT JOIN. Expressions over columns such as x = x or
-- p OR NOT p are never folded because they are UNKNOWN on NULL input.
pub fn fold_constants(e : Expr) : Expr =
  let n = Expr { ..e, args = map(fold_constants, e.args) }
  if (not(agg(n.op))
      && not(elem(n.op, ["lit", "col"]))
      && all(\(a) -> a.op == "lit", n.args)) then
    literal(evaluate(n, [], []))
  elif n.op == "ISNULL" && not(at(n.args, 0).nullable) then
    literal(JBool(false))
  elif n.op == "ISNOTNULL" && not(at(n.args, 0).nullable) then
    literal(JBool(true))
  elif n.op == "COALESCE" && not(at(n.args, 0).nullable) then
    at(n.args, 0)
  else
    n

pub fn conjuncts(e : Expr) : List(Expr) =
  if e.op == "AND" then
    append(conjuncts(at(e.args, 0)), conjuncts(at(e.args, 1)))
  else
    [e]

pub fn sources(e : Expr) : List(Int) =
  if e.op == "col" then
    [e.source]
  else
    flatten(map(sources, e.args))

fn is_true_literal(e : Expr) : Bool = e.op == "lit" && truth(e.value)

fn combine(es : List(Expr)) : Expr =
  match filter(\(e) -> not(is_true_literal(e)), es) of
    Nil => literal(JBool(true))
    Cons(e, Nil) => e
    Cons(e, rest) => Expr { ..node("AND", [e, combine(rest)]), kind = "bool" }

fn single_source(e : Expr) : Int =
  let ss = sources(e)
  if length(ss) > 0 && all(\(s) -> s == at(ss, 0), ss) then
    at(ss, 0)
  else
    -1

-- A predicate over one source is null-rejecting when it cannot be TRUE on a
-- row whose columns from that source are all NULL, i.e. on a padded row.
fn null_rejecting(e : Expr, width : Int) : Bool =
  not(truth(evaluate(e, replicate(width, JNull), [])))

-- Push a WHERE conjunct into a scan only when every referenced slot belongs
-- to one join input and the move is sound:
--   * an inner-join input, or the preserved (left) side of a left join: the
--     join keeps or pads every left row, so filtering it first is equivalent;
--   * the padded (right) side of a left join: only if the conjunct is
--     null-rejecting. Then padded rows could never pass WHERE, so the join is
--     first rewritten to an INNER JOIN, after which the push is legal.
-- Other conjuncts, including multi-source ones, remain above the joins.
-- Slot numbers remain global; scan predicates receive a prefix padding.
pub fn optimize(plan : Plan) : Plan =
  let q = plan.query
  let width = sum(map(\(t) -> length(t.columns), plan.tables))
  let terms = conjuncts(fold_constants(q.predicate))
  var outer := q.outer
  var fs := map(\(_) -> [], plan.tables)
  var rem := []
  for e in sof(terms) do
    let s = single_source(e)
    let padded = s > 0 && at(outer, s - 1)
    if s >= 0 && length(plan.tables) > 1 && (not(padded) || null_rejecting(e, width)) then
      if padded then
        outer := map(\(i) -> at(outer, i) && i /= s - 1, range(0, length(outer)))
      fs := map(\(i) -> if i == s then append(at(fs, i), [e]) else at(fs, i), range(0, length(fs)))
    else
      rem := append(rem, [e])
  let bq = Query {
    ..q,
    predicate = combine(rem),
    outer = outer,
    select = map(\(s) -> (fold_constants(fst(s)), snd(s)), q.select),
    joins = map(fold_constants, q.joins),
    having = fold_constants(q.having)
  }
  Plan { ..plan, query = bq, filters = fs }

fn join_one(
  l : List(Json),
  right : List(List(Json)),
  on : Expr,
  outer : Bool,
  width : Int
) : List(List(Json)) =
  let matches = filter(\(r) -> truth(evaluate(on, r, [])), map(\(r) -> append(l, r), right))
  if outer && length(matches) == 0 then
    [append(l, replicate(width, JNull))]
  else
    matches

fn join_rows(
  left : List(List(Json)),
  right : List(List(Json)),
  on : Expr,
  outer : Bool,
  width : Int
) : List(List(Json)) =
  flatten(map(\(l) -> join_one(l, right, on, outer, width), left))

pub type Group = Group { key: String, rows: List(List(Json)) }

fn add_group(gs : List(Group), key : String, row : List(Json)) : List(Group) =
  match gs of
    Nil => [Group { key = key, rows = [row] }]
    Cons(g, rest) =>
      if g.key == key then
        Cons(Group { ..g, rows = append(g.rows, [row]) }, rest)
      else
        Cons(g, add_group(rest, key, row))

-- Keys are compared by their JSON encoding, so NULL equals NULL per position.
fn groups_for(rows : List(List(Json)), keys : List(Expr)) : List(Group) =
  var gs := []
  for row in sof(rows) do
    let key = encode(JArr(map(\(e) -> evaluate(e, row, []), keys)))
    gs := add_group(gs, key, row)
  if length(keys) == 0 && length(rows) == 0 then
    [Group { key = "[]", rows = [] }]
  else
    gs

fn project(
  q : Query,
  row : List(Json),
  group : List(List(Json))
) : List(List(Json)) =
  if truth(evaluate(q.having, row, group)) then
    [map(\(s) -> evaluate(fst(s), row, group), q.select)]
  else
    []

fn distinct_rows(
  rows : List(List(Json)),
  seen : List(String)
) : List(List(Json)) =
  match rows of
    Nil => []
    Cons(r, rest) =>
      let key = encode(JArr(r))
      if elem(key, seen) then
        distinct_rows(rest, seen)
      else
        Cons(r, distinct_rows(rest, Cons(key, seen)))

pub fn compare_ordered(a : Json, b : Json, desc : Bool, nulls_first : Bool) : Int =
  if is_null(a) && is_null(b) then
    0
  elif is_null(a) then
    if nulls_first then -1 else 1
  elif is_null(b) then
    if nulls_first then 1 else -1
  else
    let c = compare_value(a, b)
    if desc then -c else c

fn row_compare(
  a : List(Json),
  b : List(Json),
  order : List((Int, Bool, Bool))
) : Int =
  match order of
    Nil => 0
    Cons((i, desc, nulls_first), rest) =>
      let c = compare_ordered(at(a, i), at(b, i), desc, nulls_first)
      if c == 0 then
        row_compare(a, b, rest)
      else
        c

fn insert_row(
  r : List(Json),
  rows : List(List(Json)),
  order : List((Int, Bool, Bool))
) : List(List(Json)) =
  match rows of
    Nil => [r]
    Cons(x, rest) =>
      if row_compare(r, x, order) <= 0 then
        Cons(r, rows)
      else
        Cons(x, insert_row(r, rest, order))

fn sort_rows(
  rows : List(List(Json)),
  order : List((Int, Bool, Bool))
) : List(List(Json)) =
  match rows of
    Nil => []
    Cons(r, rest) => insert_row(r, sort_rows(rest, order), order)

pub fn execute(plan : Plan) : Json =
  let q = plan.query
  var scans := []
  var offset := 0
  for i in srange(0, length(plan.tables)) do
    let t = at(plan.tables, i)
    let padding = replicate(offset, JNull)
    let predicates = at(plan.filters, i)
    let rs = filter(
        \(r) -> all(\(p) -> truth(evaluate(p, append(padding, r), [])), predicates),
        t.rows,
      )
    scans := append(scans, [rs])
    offset += length(t.columns)
  var rows := at(scans, 0)
  for i in srange(0, length(q.joins)) do
    let width = length(at(plan.tables, i + 1).columns)
    rows := join_rows(rows, at(scans, i + 1), at(q.joins, i), at(q.outer, i), width)
  let filtered = filter(\(r) -> truth(evaluate(q.predicate, r, [])), rows)
  let projected =
    if plan.aggregate then
      flatten(
          map(
              \(g) -> project(q, if length(g.rows) > 0 then at(g.rows, 0) else [], g.rows),
              groups_for(filtered, q.groups),
            ),
        )
    else
      flatten(map(\(r) -> project(q, r, []), filtered))
  let distinct =
    if q.distinct then
      distinct_rows(projected, [])
    else
      projected
  let sorted =
    if length(plan.order) > 0 then
      sort_rows(distinct, plan.order)
    else
      distinct
  let skipped = drop(q.offset, sorted)
  let final =
    if q.limit >= 0 then
      take(q.limit, skipped)
    else
      skipped
  JObj([
      ("columns", JArr(map(\(s) -> JStr(snd(s)), q.select))),
      ("rows", JArr(map(JArr, final))),
    ])

-- Typed syntax and bound logical plan. JSON is used only for wire values.
import Json (..)
import Data.String (..)
import Data.List (..)
import Data.Foldable (all, length)

pub effect Domain
  never reject(String) : Unit

pub fn demand(b : Bool, code : String) : Unit =
  if not(b) then
    reject(code)

pub fn arr(j : Json) : List(Json) =
  match j of
    JArr(xs) => xs
    _ =>
      reject("INVALID_INPUT")
      []

pub fn text(j : Json) : String =
  match j of
    JStr(s) => s
    _ =>
      reject("INVALID_INPUT")
      ""

pub fn integer(j : Json) : Int =
  match j of
    JInt(n) => n
    _ => 0

pub fn truth(j : Json) : Bool =
  match j of
    JBool(b) => b
    _ => false

-- SQL NULL is represented by JNull throughout evaluation; a boolean
-- expression therefore yields JBool(true), JBool(false), or JNull (UNKNOWN).
pub fn is_null(j : Json) : Bool =
  match j of
    JNull => true
    _ => false

pub fn getfield(j : Json, key : String) : Json =
  match j of
    JObj(xs) => lookup_field(xs, key)
    _ =>
      reject("INVALID_INPUT")
      JNull

fn lookup_field(xs : List((String, Json)), key : String) : Json =
  match xs of
    Nil =>
      reject("INVALID_INPUT")
      JNull
    Cons((k, v), rest) =>
      if k == key then
        v
      else
        lookup_field(rest, key)

pub fn fields(j : Json, names : List(String)) : Unit =
  match j of
    JObj(xs) =>
      demand(length(xs) == length(names), "INVALID_INPUT")
      demand(
          all(
              \(name) -> length(filter(\(kv) -> fst(kv) == name, xs)) == 1,
              names,
            ),
          "INVALID_INPUT",
        )
    _ => reject("INVALID_INPUT")

pub fn reserved(s : String) : Bool =
  elem(
      to_upper(s),
      split(
          32,
          "SELECT DISTINCT AS FROM INNER JOIN LEFT OUTER ON WHERE GROUP BY HAVING ORDER ASC DESC NULLS FIRST LAST LIMIT OFFSET AND OR NOT IS NULL TRUE FALSE COALESCE COUNT SUM MIN MAX",
        ),
    )

pub fn letter(c : Int) : Bool = c >= 97 && c <= 122 || c == 95

pub fn digit(c : Int) : Bool = c >= 48 && c <= 57

pub fn name_ok(s : String) : Bool =
  byte_len(s) > 0
    && letter(byte_at(s, 0))
    && all(
        \(i) -> letter(byte_at(s, i)) || digit(byte_at(s, i)),
        range(0, byte_len(s)),
      )
    && not(reserved(s))

-- "null" is the type of an untyped NULL literal; it unifies with any type.
pub fn value_type(v : Json) : String =
  match v of
    JInt(_) => "int"
    JBool(_) => "bool"
    JStr(_) => "text"
    JNull => "null"
    _ => "invalid"

pub type Column = Column {
  name: String,
  kind: String,
  nullable: Bool,
  qualifier: String,
  source: Int,
  index: Int
}

pub type Table = Table {
  name: String,
  columns: List(Column),
  rows: List(List(Json))
}

-- `nullable` is a static upper bound: false means the expression can never
-- evaluate to NULL (it accounts for declared nullability and outer-join padding).
pub type Expr = Expr {
  op: String,
  value: Json,
  qualifier: String,
  name: String,
  args: List(Expr),
  kind: String,
  nullable: Bool,
  index: Int,
  source: Int
}

pub fn node(op : String, args : List(Expr)) : Expr =
  Expr {
    op = op,
    value = JNull,
    qualifier = "",
    name = "",
    args = args,
    kind = "",
    nullable = true,
    index = -1,
    source = -1
  }

pub fn literal(v : Json) : Expr =
  Expr { ..node("lit", []), value = v, kind = value_type(v), nullable = is_null(v) }

pub fn column_ref(q : String, n : String) : Expr =
  Expr { ..node("col", []), qualifier = q, name = n }

pub fn agg(op : String) : Bool = elem(op, ["COUNT", "SUM", "MIN", "MAX"])

pub fn at(xs : List(a), i : Int) : a =
  match nth(i, xs) of
    Some(x) => x
    None => at(xs, i)

-- `outer` holds one flag per join: true for LEFT OUTER JOIN, false for INNER.
-- `order` entries are (alias, descending, nulls_first).
pub type Query = Query {
  select: List((Expr, String)),
  sources: List((String, String)),
  joins: List(Expr),
  outer: List(Bool),
  predicate: Expr,
  groups: List(Expr),
  having: Expr,
  has_having: Bool,
  order: List((String, Bool, Bool)),
  distinct: Bool,
  limit: Int,
  offset: Int
}

pub type Plan = Plan {
  query: Query,
  tables: List(Table),
  filters: List(List(Expr)),
  aggregate: Bool,
  order: List((Int, Bool, Bool))
}

pub fn validate_table(j : Json) : Table =
  fields(j, ["name", "columns", "rows"])
  let n = text(getfield(j, "name"))
  demand(name_ok(n), "INVALID_INPUT")
  let cs = map(validate_column, arr(getfield(j, "columns")))
  demand(length(cs) > 0, "INVALID_INPUT")
  demand(unique(map(\(c) -> c.name, cs)), "INVALID_INPUT")
  let rows = map(arr, arr(getfield(j, "rows")))
  for row in sof(rows) do
    demand(length(row) == length(cs), "INVALID_INPUT")
    for i in srange(0, length(cs)) do
      let c = at(cs, i)
      let v = at(row, i)
      demand(value_type(v) == c.kind || is_null(v) && c.nullable, "INVALID_INPUT")
  Table { name = n, columns = cs, rows = rows }

fn validate_column(j : Json) : Column =
  fields(j, ["name", "type", "nullable"])
  let n = text(getfield(j, "name"))
  let t = text(getfield(j, "type"))
  demand(name_ok(n) && elem(t, ["int", "text", "bool"]), "INVALID_INPUT")
  let nullable =
    match getfield(j, "nullable") of
      JBool(b) => b
      _ =>
        reject("INVALID_INPUT")
        false
  Column {
    name = n,
    kind = t,
    nullable = nullable,
    qualifier = "",
    source = 0,
    index = 0
  }

pub fn unique(xs : List(String)) : Bool =
  match xs of
    Nil => true
    Cons(x, rest) => not(elem(x, rest)) && unique(rest)

pub fn elem(x : a, xs : List(a)) : Bool given Eq(a) =
  match xs of
    Nil => false
    Cons(y, rest) => x == y || elem(x, rest)

-- Incrementally maintained query views.
--
-- A view keeps, per pipeline stage, exactly the state needed to translate a
-- delta of base rows into a delta of result rows without re-evaluating the
-- query:
--   scan     stateless filter (pushed-down predicates of optimized plans);
--   join     per join: indexes of both inputs on their equi-join key, the
--            right rows by sequence number, and the set of matched right rows
--            per left row, which drives LEFT JOIN padding and unpadding;
--   where    stateless filter;
--   group    per group: member rows, running COUNT/SUM and cached MIN/MAX
--            (recomputed from the group only when its extremum is deleted);
--   select   stateless projection;
--   distinct per distinct projected row: the set of contributing positions;
--   result   ordered map keyed by (ORDER BY values, encounter position).
-- Every intermediate row carries a position: the tuple of base-row sequence
-- numbers of its sources (0 for a NULL-padded right side). The lexicographic
-- order of positions is exactly the encounter order of the nested-loop
-- evaluation in Engine, so "first encounter" (groups, DISTINCT) is the minimum
-- position and ORDER BY ties break by position.
--
-- Deltas are normalized: a stage processes its input removals, then its
-- additions, and records the rows it emits in an event map keyed by position,
-- so a row added and removed within one delta cancels and the downstream stage
-- again sees removals before additions with distinct positions.
import Json (..)
import Model (..)
import Engine (..)
import Data.List (..)
import Data.Map (..)
import Data.Foldable (all, any, length)

alias Row = List(Json)

pub type Pos = Pos(List(Int))

pub fn pos_cmp(a : List(Int), b : List(Int)) : Int =
  match (a, b) of
    (Nil, Nil) => 0
    (Nil, _) => -1
    (_, Nil) => 1
    (Cons(x, xs), Cons(y, ys)) =>
      if x < y then
        -1
      elif x > y then
        1
      else
        pos_cmp(xs, ys)

instance eqPos : Eq(Pos)
  fn eq(a, b) =
    match (a, b) of
      (Pos(x), Pos(y)) => pos_cmp(x, y) == 0

instance ordPos : Ord(Pos)
  fn cmp(a, b) =
    match (a, b) of
      (Pos(x), Pos(y)) => pos_cmp(x, y)

fn extend(p : Pos, seq : Int) : Pos =
  match p of
    Pos(xs) => Pos(append(xs, [seq]))

-- Event map: per key, the row that existed before this delta and was removed,
-- and the row added by this delta, so that repeated changes to one key net out.
pub fn ev_remove(
  acc : Map(k, (Option(Row), Option(Row))),
  key : k,
  row : Row
) : Map(k, (Option(Row), Option(Row))) given Ord(k) =
  match map_lookup(key, acc) of
    Some((old, Some(_))) => map_insert(key, (old, None), acc)
    Some(_) => acc
    None => map_insert(key, (Some(row), None), acc)

pub fn ev_add(
  acc : Map(k, (Option(Row), Option(Row))),
  key : k,
  row : Row
) : Map(k, (Option(Row), Option(Row))) given Ord(k) =
  match map_lookup(key, acc) of
    Some((old, _)) => map_insert(key, (old, Some(row)), acc)
    None => map_insert(key, (None, Some(row)), acc)

pub fn ev_lists(
  acc : Map(k, (Option(Row), Option(Row)))
) : (List((k, Row)), List((k, Row))) =
  var rem := []
  var add := []
  for kv in sof(map_to_list(acc)) do
    let (k, (old, new)) = kv
    match old of
      Some(r) => rem := Cons((k, r), rem)
      None => ()
    match new of
      Some(r) => add := Cons((k, r), add)
      None => ()
  (reverse(rem), reverse(add))

pub type Delta = Delta { removed: List((Pos, Row)), added: List((Pos, Row)) }

fn empty_delta() : Delta = Delta { removed = [], added = [] }

-- Stage events are keyed by position and row content: a stage may emit the
-- removal of one row and the addition of a different row at one position in
-- either order (DISTINCT and grouping re-emit per touched entry), and only an
-- addition and removal of the very same row may cancel.
fn drop_row(
  acc : Map((Pos, String), (Option(Row), Option(Row))),
  p : Pos,
  row : Row
) : Map((Pos, String), (Option(Row), Option(Row))) =
  ev_remove(acc, (p, encode(JArr(row))), row)

fn put_row(
  acc : Map((Pos, String), (Option(Row), Option(Row))),
  p : Pos,
  row : Row
) : Map((Pos, String), (Option(Row), Option(Row))) =
  ev_add(acc, (p, encode(JArr(row))), row)

fn delta_of(acc : Map((Pos, String), (Option(Row), Option(Row)))) : Delta =
  let (r, a) = ev_lists(acc)
  let strip = \(kr) -> let ((p, _), row) = kr in (p, row)
  Delta { removed = map(strip, r), added = map(strip, a) }

fn retract(
  acc : Map((Pos, String), (Option(Row), Option(Row))),
  out : Option((Pos, Row))
) : Map((Pos, String), (Option(Row), Option(Row))) =
  match out of
    Some((p, r)) => drop_row(acc, p, r)
    None => acc

fn emit(
  acc : Map((Pos, String), (Option(Row), Option(Row))),
  out : Option((Pos, Row))
) : Map((Pos, String), (Option(Row), Option(Row))) =
  match out of
    Some((p, r)) => put_row(acc, p, r)
    None => acc

fn same_output(a : Option((Pos, Row)), b : Option((Pos, Row))) : Bool =
  match (a, b) of
    (None, None) => true
    (Some((p, r)), Some((q, s))) => p == q && encode(JArr(r)) == encode(JArr(s))
    _ => false

-- Column slots are global across the joined row; a scan or right-side key
-- expression is rebased so it can be evaluated on a single table's row.
fn rebase(e : Expr, offset : Int) : Expr =
  if e.op == "col" then
    Expr { ..e, index = e.index - offset }
  else
    Expr { ..e, args = map(\(a) -> rebase(a, offset), e.args) }

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- scans
type Scan = Scan { offset: Int, width: Int, filters: List(Expr) }

fn scan_pass(s : Scan, row : Row) : Bool =
  all(\(p) -> truth(evaluate(p, row, [])), s.filters)

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- joins
-- `lkeys` are evaluated on the left prefix row (global slots), `rkeys` on the
-- right table's own row (rebased). A NULL key value can never satisfy the
-- equality conjunct it came from, so such rows are kept out of the indexes.
-- Without an equality conjunct every row shares one bucket (nested loop).
type Stage = Stage {
  on: Expr,
  outer: Bool,
  lkeys: List(Expr),
  rkeys: List(Expr),
  rwidth: Int,
  lindex: Map(String, Map(Pos, Row)),
  rindex: Map(String, Map(Int, Row)),
  rrows: Map(Int, Row),
  matched: Map(Pos, Map(Int, Unit))
}

fn key_of(keys : List(Expr), row : Row) : Option(String) =
  let vals = map(\(e) -> evaluate(e, row, []), keys)
  if any(is_null, vals) then
    None
  else
    Some(encode(JArr(vals)))

fn bucket_map(idx : Map(String, Map(k, Row)), key : String) : Map(k, Row) =
  match map_lookup(key, idx) of
    Some(b) => b
    None => map_empty

fn index_add(
  idx : Map(String, Map(k, Row)),
  key : String,
  k : k,
  row : Row
) : Map(String, Map(k, Row)) given Ord(k) =
  map_insert(key, map_insert(k, row, bucket_map(idx, key)), idx)

fn index_remove(
  idx : Map(String, Map(k, Row)),
  key : String,
  k : k
) : Map(String, Map(k, Row)) given Ord(k) =
  let b = map_delete(k, bucket_map(idx, key))
  if map_size(b) == 0 then
    map_delete(key, idx)
  else
    map_insert(key, b, idx)

fn matched_of(st : Stage, lp : Pos) : Map(Int, Unit) =
  match map_lookup(lp, st.matched) of
    Some(m) => m
    None => map_empty

fn row_at(m : Map(Int, Row), seq : Int) : Row =
  match map_lookup(seq, m) of
    Some(r) => r
    None => []

fn padded(lrow : Row, width : Int) : Row = append(lrow, replicate(width, JNull))

fn equi_keys(on : Expr, i : Int, offset : Int) : (List(Expr), List(Expr)) =
  var lk := []
  var rk := []
  for c in sof(conjuncts(on)) do
    if c.op == "=" && length(c.args) == 2 then
      let x = at(c.args, 0)
      let y = at(c.args, 1)
      let sx = sources(x)
      let sy = sources(y)
      if all(\(s) -> s < i, sx) && length(sy) > 0 && all(\(s) -> s == i, sy) then
        lk := append(lk, [x])
        rk := append(rk, [rebase(y, offset)])
      elif all(\(s) -> s < i, sy) && length(sx) > 0 && all(\(s) -> s == i, sx) then
        lk := append(lk, [y])
        rk := append(rk, [rebase(x, offset)])
  (lk, rk)

-- A delta of the left input: retract every output row derived from a removed
-- left row (its matches, or its padding), then probe the right index for each
-- added left row.
fn join_left(st : Stage, d : Delta) : (Stage, Delta) =
  var s := st
  var ev := map_empty
  for lr in sof(d.removed) do
    let (lp, lrow) = lr
    let ms = matched_of(s, lp)
    if map_size(ms) == 0 then
      if s.outer then
        ev := drop_row(ev, extend(lp, 0), padded(lrow, s.rwidth))
    else
      for seq in sof(map_keys(ms)) do
        ev := drop_row(ev, extend(lp, seq), append(lrow, row_at(s.rrows, seq)))
      s := Stage { ..s, matched = map_delete(lp, s.matched) }
    match key_of(s.lkeys, lrow) of
      Some(k) => s := Stage { ..s, lindex = index_remove(s.lindex, k, lp) }
      None => ()
  for la in sof(d.added) do
    let (lp, lrow) = la
    var found := map_empty
    match key_of(s.lkeys, lrow) of
      Some(k) =>
        s := Stage { ..s, lindex = index_add(s.lindex, k, lp, lrow) }
        for sr in sof(map_to_list(bucket_map(s.rindex, k))) do
          let (seq, rrow) = sr
          let full = append(lrow, rrow)
          if truth(evaluate(s.on, full, [])) then
            found := map_insert(seq, (), found)
            ev := put_row(ev, extend(lp, seq), full)
      None => ()
    if map_size(found) == 0 then
      if s.outer then
        ev := put_row(ev, extend(lp, 0), padded(lrow, s.rwidth))
    else
      s := Stage { ..s, matched = map_insert(lp, found, s.matched) }
  (s, delta_of(ev))

-- A delta of the right input: a removed right row retracts its matches and
-- pads a left row that lost its last match; an added right row unpads a left
-- row that gains its first match and adds the new matches.
fn join_right(
  st : Stage,
  removed : List((Int, Row)),
  added : List((Int, Row))
) : (Stage, Delta) =
  var s := st
  var ev := map_empty
  for rr in sof(removed) do
    let (seq, rrow) = rr
    s := Stage { ..s, rrows = map_delete(seq, s.rrows) }
    match key_of(s.rkeys, rrow) of
      Some(k) =>
        s := Stage { ..s, rindex = index_remove(s.rindex, k, seq) }
        for lr in sof(map_to_list(bucket_map(s.lindex, k))) do
          let (lp, lrow) = lr
          let full = append(lrow, rrow)
          if truth(evaluate(s.on, full, [])) then
            ev := drop_row(ev, extend(lp, seq), full)
            let ms = map_delete(seq, matched_of(s, lp))
            if map_size(ms) == 0 then
              s := Stage { ..s, matched = map_delete(lp, s.matched) }
              if s.outer then
                ev := put_row(ev, extend(lp, 0), padded(lrow, s.rwidth))
            else
              s := Stage { ..s, matched = map_insert(lp, ms, s.matched) }
      None => ()
  for ra in sof(added) do
    let (seq, rrow) = ra
    s := Stage { ..s, rrows = map_insert(seq, rrow, s.rrows) }
    match key_of(s.rkeys, rrow) of
      Some(k) =>
        s := Stage { ..s, rindex = index_add(s.rindex, k, seq, rrow) }
        for lr in sof(map_to_list(bucket_map(s.lindex, k))) do
          let (lp, lrow) = lr
          let full = append(lrow, rrow)
          if truth(evaluate(s.on, full, [])) then
            let ms = matched_of(s, lp)
            if map_size(ms) == 0 && s.outer then
              ev := drop_row(ev, extend(lp, 0), padded(lrow, s.rwidth))
            s := Stage { ..s, matched = map_insert(lp, map_insert(seq, (), ms), s.matched) }
            ev := put_row(ev, extend(lp, seq), full)
      None => ()
  (s, delta_of(ev))

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- where / select
fn where_delta(pred : Expr, d : Delta) : Delta =
  let keep = \(pr) -> truth(evaluate(pred, snd(pr), []))
  Delta { removed = filter(keep, d.removed), added = filter(keep, d.added) }

fn project_delta(sels : List(Expr), d : Delta) : Delta =
  let f = \(pr) -> (fst(pr), map(\(e) -> evaluate(e, snd(pr), []), sels))
  Delta { removed = map(f, d.removed), added = map(f, d.added) }

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- aggregation
-- Aggregate nodes of SELECT/HAVING are numbered; the templates carry `aggref`
-- placeholders that are replaced by the maintained values before evaluation.
type AggState = AggState { n: Int, total: Int, lo: Json, hi: Json }

type GroupState = GroupState {
  rows: Map(Pos, Row),
  aggs: List(AggState),
  emitted: Option((Pos, Row))
}

fn agg_empty() : AggState = AggState { n = 0, total = 0, lo = JNull, hi = JNull }

fn agg_add(a : AggState, v : Json) : AggState =
  if is_null(v) then
    a
  else
    AggState {
      n = a.n + 1,
      total = a.total + integer(v),
      lo = if a.n == 0 || compare_value(v, a.lo) < 0 then v else a.lo,
      hi = if a.n == 0 || compare_value(v, a.hi) > 0 then v else a.hi
    }

fn recompute(arg : Expr, rows : Map(Pos, Row), minimum : Bool) : Json =
  var best := JNull
  for r in sof(map_values(rows)) do
    let v = evaluate(arg, r, [])
    if not(is_null(v)) then
      if is_null(best) || (compare_value(v, best) < 0) == minimum then
        best := v
  best

-- `rows` is the group after the removal; the extremum is recomputed only when
-- the removed value equals it.
fn agg_remove(a : AggState, v : Json, arg : Expr, rows : Map(Pos, Row)) : AggState =
  if is_null(v) then
    a
  elif a.n == 1 then
    agg_empty()
  else
    AggState {
      n = a.n - 1,
      total = a.total - integer(v),
      lo = if compare_value(v, a.lo) == 0 then recompute(arg, rows, true) else a.lo,
      hi = if compare_value(v, a.hi) == 0 then recompute(arg, rows, false) else a.hi
    }

fn agg_value(e : Expr, a : AggState, count : Int) : Json =
  if e.op == "COUNT" then
    JInt(if length(e.args) == 0 then count else a.n)
  elif a.n == 0 then
    JNull
  elif e.op == "SUM" then
    JInt(a.total)
  elif e.op == "MIN" then
    a.lo
  else
    a.hi

fn collect_aggs(e : Expr, acc : List(Expr)) : (Expr, List(Expr)) =
  if agg(e.op) then
    (Expr { ..e, op = "aggref", index = length(acc) }, append(acc, [e]))
  else
    let (args, out) = collect_list(e.args, acc)
    (Expr { ..e, args = args }, out)

fn collect_list(es : List(Expr), acc : List(Expr)) : (List(Expr), List(Expr)) =
  match es of
    Nil => ([], acc)
    Cons(x, rest) =>
      let (x2, acc2) = collect_aggs(x, acc)
      let (rest2, acc3) = collect_list(rest, acc2)
      (Cons(x2, rest2), acc3)

fn subst(e : Expr, vals : List(Json)) : Expr =
  if e.op == "aggref" then
    literal(at(vals, e.index))
  else
    Expr { ..e, args = map(\(a) -> subst(a, vals), e.args) }

fn group_add(g : GroupState, aggs : List(Expr), p : Pos, row : Row) : GroupState =
  let states = zip_with(
      \(e : Expr, a : AggState) -> if length(e.args) == 0 then a else agg_add(a, evaluate(at(e.args, 0), row, [])),
      aggs,
      g.aggs,
    )
  GroupState { ..g, rows = map_insert(p, row, g.rows), aggs = states }

fn group_remove(g : GroupState, aggs : List(Expr), p : Pos, row : Row) : GroupState =
  let rows = map_delete(p, g.rows)
  let states = zip_with(
      \(e : Expr, a : AggState) -> if length(e.args) == 0 then a else agg_remove(a, evaluate(at(e.args, 0), row, []), at(e.args, 0), rows),
      aggs,
      g.aggs,
    )
  GroupState { ..g, rows = rows, aggs = states }

fn new_group(v : View) : GroupState =
  GroupState { rows = map_empty, aggs = map(\(_) -> agg_empty(), v.aggs), emitted = None }

fn group_key(v : View, row : Row) : String =
  encode(JArr(map(\(e) -> evaluate(e, row, []), v.plan.query.groups)))

fn group_output(v : View, g : GroupState) : Option((Pos, Row)) =
  let vals = zip_with(\(e : Expr, a : AggState) -> agg_value(e, a, map_size(g.rows)), v.aggs, g.aggs)
  let (pos, row) =
    match map_min(g.rows) of
      Some((p, r)) => (if v.grouped then p else Pos([]), r)
      None => (Pos([]), [])
  if truth(evaluate(subst(v.having_t, vals), row, [])) then
    Some((pos, map(\(s) -> evaluate(subst(s, vals), row, []), v.select_t)))
  else
    None

fn agg_apply(v : View, d : Delta) : (View, Delta) =
  var gs := v.groups
  var touched := map_empty
  if not(v.grouped) then
    touched := map_insert("[]", (), touched)
  for pr in sof(d.removed) do
    let (p, row) = pr
    let key = group_key(v, row)
    match map_lookup(key, gs) of
      Some(g) => gs := map_insert(key, group_remove(g, v.aggs, p, row), gs)
      None => ()
    touched := map_insert(key, (), touched)
  for pa in sof(d.added) do
    let (p, row) = pa
    let key = group_key(v, row)
    let g =
      match map_lookup(key, gs) of
        Some(g0) => g0
        None => new_group(v)
    gs := map_insert(key, group_add(g, v.aggs, p, row), gs)
    touched := map_insert(key, (), touched)
  var ev := map_empty
  for key in sof(map_keys(touched)) do
    let g =
      match map_lookup(key, gs) of
        Some(g0) => g0
        None => new_group(v)
    if v.grouped && map_size(g.rows) == 0 then
      gs := map_delete(key, gs)
      ev := retract(ev, g.emitted)
    else
      let new = group_output(v, g)
      if not(same_output(g.emitted, new)) then
        ev := emit(retract(ev, g.emitted), new)
        gs := map_insert(key, GroupState { ..g, emitted = new }, gs)
      elif not(map_member(key, gs)) then
        gs := map_insert(key, g, gs)
  (View { ..v, groups = gs }, delta_of(ev))

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- distinct
type Entry = Entry { row: Row, members: Map(Pos, Unit), emitted: Option(Pos) }

fn distinct_apply(v : View, d : Delta) : (View, Delta) =
  var es := v.distinct
  var touched := map_empty
  for pr in sof(d.removed) do
    let (p, row) = pr
    let key = encode(JArr(row))
    match map_lookup(key, es) of
      Some(e) => es := map_insert(key, Entry { ..e, members = map_delete(p, e.members) }, es)
      None => ()
    touched := map_insert(key, (), touched)
  for pa in sof(d.added) do
    let (p, row) = pa
    let key = encode(JArr(row))
    let e =
      match map_lookup(key, es) of
        Some(e0) => e0
        None => Entry { row = row, members = map_empty, emitted = None }
    es := map_insert(key, Entry { ..e, members = map_insert(p, (), e.members) }, es)
    touched := map_insert(key, (), touched)
  var ev := map_empty
  for key in sof(map_keys(touched)) do
    match map_lookup(key, es) of
      Some(e) =>
        let new =
          match map_min(e.members) of
            Some((p, _)) => Some(p)
            None => None
        if new /= e.emitted then
          match e.emitted of
            Some(p) => ev := drop_row(ev, p, e.row)
            None => ()
          match new of
            Some(p) => ev := put_row(ev, p, e.row)
            None => ()
        if map_size(e.members) == 0 then
          es := map_delete(key, es)
        else
          es := map_insert(key, Entry { ..e, emitted = new }, es)
      None => ()
  (View { ..v, distinct = es }, delta_of(ev))

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- result
-- Ordered by the ORDER BY values under the query's directions and NULL
-- placement, then by encounter position, which makes the order total and
-- reproduces the stable sort of a fresh query.
pub type SortKey = SortKey { vals: List(Json), spec: List((Int, Bool, Bool)), pos: Pos }

fn vals_cmp(xs : List(Json), ys : List(Json), spec : List((Int, Bool, Bool))) : Int =
  match (xs, ys, spec) of
    (Cons(x, xr), Cons(y, yr), Cons((_, desc, nf), sr)) =>
      let c = compare_ordered(x, y, desc, nf)
      if c /= 0 then
        c
      else
        vals_cmp(xr, yr, sr)
    _ => 0

fn sort_cmp(a : SortKey, b : SortKey) : Int =
  let c = vals_cmp(a.vals, b.vals, a.spec)
  if c /= 0 then
    c
  else
    cmp(a.pos, b.pos)

instance eqSortKey : Eq(SortKey)
  fn eq(a, b) = sort_cmp(a, b) == 0

instance ordSortKey : Ord(SortKey)
  fn cmp(a, b) = sort_cmp(a, b)

fn sort_key(spec : List((Int, Bool, Bool)), p : Pos, row : Row) : SortKey =
  SortKey { vals = map(\(o) -> let (i, _, _) = o in at(row, i), spec), spec = spec, pos = p }

fn result_apply(v : View, d : Delta) : View =
  var m := v.result
  for pr in sof(d.removed) do
    let (p, row) = pr
    m := map_delete(sort_key(v.plan.order, p, row), m)
  for pa in sof(d.added) do
    let (p, row) = pa
    m := map_insert(sort_key(v.plan.order, p, row), row, m)
  View { ..v, result = m }

fn first_go(m : Map(k, v), n : Int, acc : List(v)) : (List(v), Int) =
  if n <= 0 then
    (acc, 0)
  else
    match m of
      Tip => (acc, n)
      Bin(_, _, x, l, r) =>
        let (acc1, n1) = first_go(l, n, acc)
        if n1 <= 0 then
          (acc1, 0)
        else
          first_go(r, n1 - 1, Cons(x, acc1))

-- The first `n` values in key order, visiting only that prefix of the tree.
fn map_first_values(m : Map(k, v), n : Int) : List(v) =
  let (acc, _) = first_go(m, n, [])
  reverse(acc)

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- views
pub type View = View {
  plan: Plan,
  sources: List(Int),
  scans: List(Scan),
  stages: List(Stage),
  grouped: Bool,
  aggs: List(Expr),
  select_t: List(Expr),
  having_t: Expr,
  groups: Map(String, GroupState),
  distinct: Map(String, Entry),
  result: Map(SortKey, Row)
}

fn downstream(v : View, d : Delta) : View =
  let q = v.plan.query
  let d1 = where_delta(q.predicate, d)
  let (v2, d2) =
    if v.plan.aggregate then
      agg_apply(v, d1)
    else
      (v, project_delta(v.select_t, d1))
  let (v3, d3) =
    if q.distinct then
      distinct_apply(v2, d2)
    else
      (v2, d2)
  result_apply(v3, d3)

-- Apply a net change of one source's base rows (by sequence number) and
-- propagate it through the stages that depend on that source.
pub fn apply_source(
  v : View,
  i : Int,
  removed : List((Int, Row)),
  added : List((Int, Row))
) : View =
  let scan = at(v.scans, i)
  let rem = filter(\(sr) -> scan_pass(scan, snd(sr)), removed)
  let add = filter(\(sr) -> scan_pass(scan, snd(sr)), added)
  if length(rem) == 0 && length(add) == 0 then
    v
  else
    var stages := v.stages
    var d := empty_delta()
    var start := 0
    if i == 0 then
      let lift = \(sr) -> (Pos([fst(sr)]), snd(sr))
      d := Delta { removed = map(lift, rem), added = map(lift, add) }
    else
      let (st, d2) = join_right(at(stages, i - 1), rem, add)
      stages := list_set(stages, i - 1, st)
      d := d2
      start := i
    for j in srange(start, length(stages)) do
      let (st, d2) = join_left(at(stages, j), d)
      stages := list_set(stages, j, st)
      d := d2
    downstream(View { ..v, stages = stages }, d)

-- `loads` holds, per source, the current rows of its base table as
-- (sequence, row) in encounter order. Sources are loaded last to first so
-- every row flows through the pipeline exactly once against fully indexed
-- right inputs.
pub fn create_view(plan : Plan, sources : List(Int), loads : List(List((Int, Row)))) : View =
  let q = plan.query
  var offset := 0
  var scans := []
  var stages := []
  for i in srange(0, length(plan.tables)) do
    let width = length(at(plan.tables, i).columns)
    let base = offset
    scans := append(scans, [Scan { offset = base, width = width, filters = map(\(p) -> rebase(p, base), at(plan.filters, i)) }])
    if i > 0 then
      let on = at(q.joins, i - 1)
      let (lk, rk) = equi_keys(on, i, base)
      stages := append(
          stages,
          [Stage {
            on = on,
            outer = at(q.outer, i - 1),
            lkeys = lk,
            rkeys = rk,
            rwidth = width,
            lindex = map_empty,
            rindex = map_empty,
            rrows = map_empty,
            matched = map_empty
          }],
        )
    offset += width
  var aggs := []
  var sels := []
  for s in sof(q.select) do
    let (e, acc) = collect_aggs(fst(s), aggs)
    aggs := acc
    sels := append(sels, [e])
  let (hav, all_aggs) = collect_aggs(q.having, aggs)
  var v := View {
    plan = plan,
    sources = sources,
    scans = scans,
    stages = stages,
    grouped = length(q.groups) > 0,
    aggs = all_aggs,
    select_t = sels,
    having_t = hav,
    groups = map_empty,
    distinct = map_empty,
    result = map_empty
  }
  for i in sof(reverse(range(0, length(loads)))) do
    v := apply_source(v, i, [], at(loads, i))
  -- A global aggregate emits its single row even over empty input.
  downstream(v, empty_delta())

pub fn view_columns(v : View) : List(Json) =
  map(\(s) -> JStr(snd(s)), v.plan.query.select)

pub fn view_rows(v : View) : List(Row) =
  let q = v.plan.query
  let rows =
    if q.limit >= 0 then
      map_first_values(v.result, q.offset + q.limit)
    else
      map_values(v.result)
  let skipped = drop(q.offset, rows)
  if q.limit >= 0 then
    take(q.limit, skipped)
  else
    skipped

defs.source:
fn check(e : Expr, columns : List(Column), allow : Bool, inside : Bool) : Expr =
  if e.op == "col" then
    let matches = filter(
        \(c) -> c.name == e.name && (e.qualifier == "" || e.qualifier == c.qualifier),
        columns,
      )
    demand(length(matches) > 0, "UNKNOWN_COLUMN")
    demand(length(matches) == 1, "AMBIGUOUS_COLUMN")
    let c = at(matches, 0)
    Expr { ..e, index = c.index, source = c.source, kind = c.kind, nullable = c.nullable }
  elif e.op == "lit" then
    e
  else
    let isagg = agg(e.op)
    demand(not(isagg) || allow && not(inside), "INVALID_AGGREGATION")
    let args = map(\(a) -> check(a, columns, allow, inside || isagg), e.args)
    let ts = map(\(a) -> a.kind, args)
    let typed = filter(\(t) -> t /= "null", ts)
    let common = if length(typed) > 0 then at(typed, 0) else "null"
    let agree = all(\(t) -> t == common, typed)
    let anynull = any(\(a) -> a.nullable, args)
    let (kind, nullable) =
      if e.op == "COUNT" then
        ("int", false)
      elif e.op == "SUM" then
        demand(all(\(t) -> fits(t, "int"), ts), "TYPE_ERROR")
        ("int", true)
      elif elem(e.op, ["MIN", "MAX"]) then
        demand(elem(at(ts, 0), ["int", "text", "null"]), "TYPE_ERROR")
        (at(ts, 0), true)
      elif elem(e.op, ["+", "-", "*"]) then
        demand(all(\(t) -> fits(t, "int"), ts), "TYPE_ERROR")
        ("int", anynull)
      elif elem(e.op, ["NOT", "AND", "OR"]) then
        demand(all(\(t) -> fits(t, "bool"), ts), "TYPE_ERROR")
        ("bool", anynull)
      elif elem(e.op, ["ISNULL", "ISNOTNULL"]) then
        ("bool", false)
      elif e.op == "COALESCE" then
        demand(agree, "TYPE_ERROR")
        (common, all(\(a) -> a.nullable, args))
      else
        demand(agree && (common /= "bool" || elem(e.op, ["=", "<>"])), "TYPE_ERROR")
        ("bool", anynull)
    Expr { ..e, args = args, kind = kind, nullable = nullable }

fn base_of(t : Table) : Base =
  var by_id := map_empty
  var by_seq := map_empty
  var used := map_empty
  var n := 0
  for row in sof(t.rows) do
    n += 1
    by_id := map_insert(n, (n, row), by_id)
    by_seq := map_insert(n, row, by_seq)
    used := map_insert(n, (), used)
  Base {
    table = Table { ..t, rows = [] },
    by_id = by_id,
    by_seq = by_seq,
    used = used,
    next_seq = n + 1
  }

fn validate_change(ch : Json) : Unit =
  let op = op_of(ch)
  if op == "insert" || op == "update" then
    demand(has_fields(ch, ["op", "table", "id", "row"]), "INVALID_COMMAND")
    match getfield(ch, "row") of
      JArr(_) => ()
      _ => bad()
  elif op == "delete" then
    demand(has_fields(ch, ["op", "table", "id"]), "INVALID_COMMAND")
  else
    bad()
  demand(table_name_ok(str_field(ch, "table")), "INVALID_COMMAND")
  match getfield(ch, "id") of
    JInt(n) => demand(n >= 1 && n <= 2147483647, "INVALID_COMMAND")
    _ => bad()

fn validate_command(c : Json) : Unit =
  let op = op_of(c)
  if op == "create" then
    demand(has_fields(c, ["op", "view", "sql", "optimize"]), "INVALID_COMMAND")
    demand(view_name_ok(str_field(c, "view")), "INVALID_COMMAND")
    let ignored = str_field(c, "sql")
    match getfield(c, "optimize") of
      JBool(_) => ()
      _ => bad()
  elif op == "read" || op == "drop" then
    demand(has_fields(c, ["op", "view"]), "INVALID_COMMAND")
    demand(view_name_ok(str_field(c, "view")), "INVALID_COMMAND")
  elif op == "apply" then
    demand(has_fields(c, ["op", "changes"]), "INVALID_COMMAND")
    match getfield(c, "changes") of
      JArr(cs) =>
        demand(length(cs) >= 1 && length(cs) <= 200, "INVALID_COMMAND")
        for ch in sof(cs) do
          validate_change(ch)
      _ => bad()
  else
    bad()

defs.name: apply_batch
defs.source:
fn apply_batch(db : Db, changes : List(Json)) : Db =
  var tables := db.tables
  var deltas := map(\(_) -> map_empty, db.tables)
  for ch in sof(changes) do
    let op = text(getfield(ch, "op"))
    let ti = find_base(tables, text(getfield(ch, "table")))
    var b : Base := at(tables, ti)
    let id = integer(getfield(ch, "id"))
    var ev := at(deltas, ti)
    if op == "delete" then
      match map_lookup(id, b.by_id) of
        Some((seq, old)) =>
          tables := list_set(
              tables,
              ti,
              Base { ..b, by_id = map_delete(id, b.by_id), by_seq = map_delete(seq, b.by_seq) },
            )
          ev := ev_remove(ev, seq, old)
        None => reject("UNKNOWN_ROW")
    else
      let row = validate_row(b.table, getfield(ch, "row"))
      if op == "insert" then
        demand(not(map_member(id, b.used)), "ROW_ID_USED")
        let seq = b.next_seq
        tables := list_set(
            tables,
            ti,
            Base {
              ..b,
              by_id = map_insert(id, (seq, row), b.by_id),
              by_seq = map_insert(seq, row, b.by_seq),
              used = map_insert(id, (), b.used),
              next_seq = seq + 1
            },
          )
        ev := ev_add(ev, seq, row)
      else
        match map_lookup(id, b.by_id) of
          Some((seq, old)) =>
            tables := list_set(
                tables,
                ti,
                Base { ..b, by_id = map_insert(id, (seq, row), b.by_id), by_seq = map_insert(seq, row, b.by_seq) },
              )
            ev := ev_add(ev_remove(ev, seq, old), seq, row)
          None => reject("UNKNOWN_ROW")
    deltas := list_set(deltas, ti, ev)
  var views := db.views
  for nv in sof(map_to_list(db.views)) do
    let (name, view) = nv
    var v : View := view
    for i in srange(0, length(v.sources)) do
      let (rem, add) = ev_lists(at(deltas, at(v.sources, i)))
      if length(rem) > 0 || length(add) > 0 then
        v := apply_source(v, i, rem, add)
    views := map_insert(name, v, views)
  Db { tables = tables, views = views, revision = db.revision + 1 }

defs.name: evaluate
defs.source:
fn evaluate(e : Expr, row : List(Json), group : List(List(Json))) : Json =
  let op = e.op
  if op == "lit" then
    e.value
  elif op == "col" then
    at(row, e.index)
  elif agg(op) then
    if op == "COUNT" && length(e.args) == 0 then
      JInt(length(group))
    else
      -- Every aggregate other than COUNT(*) ignores NULL inputs.
      let vs = filter(\(v) -> not(is_null(v)), map(\(r) -> evaluate(at(e.args, 0), r, []), group))
      if op == "COUNT" then
        JInt(length(vs))
      elif length(vs) == 0 then
        JNull
      elif op == "SUM" then
        JInt(sum(map(integer, vs)))
      else
        extremum(vs, op == "MIN")
  elif op == "COALESCE" then
    first_non_null(map(\(a) -> evaluate(a, row, group), e.args))
  else
    let a = evaluate(at(e.args, 0), row, group)
    if op == "ISNULL" then
      JBool(is_null(a))
    elif op == "ISNOTNULL" then
      JBool(not(is_null(a)))
    elif op == "NOT" then
      if is_null(a) then
        JNull
      else
        JBool(not(truth(a)))
    else
      let b = evaluate(at(e.args, 1), row, group)
      if op == "AND" then
        if is_false(a) || is_false(b) then
          JBool(false)
        elif is_null(a) || is_null(b) then
          JNull
        else
          JBool(true)
      elif op == "OR" then
        if truth(a) || truth(b) then
          JBool(true)
        elif is_null(a) || is_null(b) then
          JNull
        else
          JBool(false)
      elif is_null(a) || is_null(b) then
        -- Arithmetic and ordinary comparison propagate NULL.
        JNull
      elif op == "+" then
        JInt(integer(a) + integer(b))
      elif op == "-" then
        JInt(integer(a) - integer(b))
      elif op == "*" then
        JInt(integer(a) * integer(b))
      else
        let c = compare_value(a, b)
        JBool(
            if op == "=" then c == 0 elif op == "<>" then c /= 0 elif op == "<" then c < 0 elif op == ">" then c > 0 elif op == "<=" then c <= 0 else c >= 0,
          )

fn extremum(vs : List(Json), minimum : Bool) : Json =
  match vs of
    Nil => JNull
    Cons(v, Nil) => v
    Cons(v, rest) =>
      let b = extremum(rest, minimum)
      if (compare_value(v, b) < 0) == minimum then
        v
      else
        b

fn fold_constants(e : Expr) : Expr =
  let n = Expr { ..e, args = map(fold_constants, e.args) }
  if (not(agg(n.op))
      && not(elem(n.op, ["lit", "col"]))

    literal(JBool(true))

fn lex(s : String, i : Int) : List(Token) =
  if i >= byte_len(s) then
    [tok("$END")]
  else
    let c = byte_at(s, i)
    if elem(c, [32, 9, 10, 13]) then
      lex(s, i + 1)
    elif c == 39 then
      let (v, j) = scan_string(s, i + 1, "")
      Cons(Token { word = "LITERAL", value = JStr(v) }, lex(s, j))
    elif digit(c) then
      let j = scan_word(s, i, true)
      let n =
        match parse_int(slice(s, i, j)) of
          Some(v) => v
          None => 0
      Cons(Token { word = "NUMBER", value = JInt(n) }, lex(s, j))
    elif letter(c) || c >= 65 && c <= 90 then
      let j = scan_word(s, i, false)
      let w = slice(s, i, j)
      Cons(tok(if reserved(w) then to_upper(w) else w), lex(s, j))
    else
      let two = slice(s, i, min(i + 2, byte_len(s)))
      if elem(two, ["<>", "<=", ">="]) then
        Cons(tok(two), lex(s, i + 2))
      else
        demand(
            elem(c, [40, 41, 44, 46, 59, 43, 45, 42, 61, 60, 62]),
            "PARSE_ERROR",
          )
        Cons(tok(str_of_char(chr(c))), lex(s, i + 1))

fn expression(minimum : Int) : Expr =
  let t = pop()
  let w = t.word
  let e =
    if w == "NOT" then
      node(w, [expression(3)])
    elif w == "(" then
      let x = expression(1)
      expect(")")
      x
    elif w == "-" then
      literal(JInt(-natural()))
    elif elem(w, ["NUMBER", "LITERAL"]) then
      literal(t.value)
    elif elem(w, ["TRUE", "FALSE"]) then
      literal(JBool(w == "TRUE"))
    elif w == "NULL" then
      literal(JNull)
    elif w == "COALESCE" then
      expect("(")
      let args = arguments()
      expect(")")
      demand(length(args) >= 2, "PARSE_ERROR")
      node(w, args)
    elif agg(w) then
      expect("(")
      let args =
        if w == "COUNT" && accept("*") then
          []
        else
          [expression(1)]
      expect(")")
      node(w, args)
    else
      demand(name_ok(w), "PARSE_ERROR")
      if accept(".") then
        column_ref(w, name())
      else
        column_ref("", w)
  binary(e, minimum, false)

fn query() : Query =
  expect("SELECT")
  let distinct = accept("DISTINCT")
  let sels = selections()
  expect("FROM")
  let (ss, js, os) = join_sources([source()], [], [])
  let pred =
    if accept("WHERE") then
      expression(1)
    else
      literal(JBool(true))
  let groups =
    if accept("GROUP") then
      expect("BY")
      group_keys()
    else
      []
  let hh = accept("HAVING")
  let hav =
    if hh then
      expression(1)
    else
      literal(JBool(true))
  let order =
    if accept("ORDER") then
      expect("BY")
      order_keys()
    else
      []
  let lim =
    if accept("LIMIT") then
      natural()
    else
      -1
  let off =
    if lim >= 0 && accept("OFFSET") then
      natural()
    else
      0
  let ignored = accept(";")
  demand(peek() == "$END", "PARSE_ERROR")
  Query {
    select = sels,
    sources = ss,
    joins = js,
    outer = os,
    predicate = pred,
    groups = groups,
    having = hav,
    has_having = hh,
    order = order,
    distinct = distinct,
    limit = lim,
    offset = off
  }

fn join_left(st : Stage, d : Delta) : (Stage, Delta) =
  var s := st
  var ev := map_empty
  for lr in sof(d.removed) do
    let (lp, lrow) = lr
    let ms = matched_of(s, lp)
    if map_size(ms) == 0 then
      if s.outer then
        ev := drop_row(ev, extend(lp, 0), padded(lrow, s.rwidth))
    else
      for seq in sof(map_keys(ms)) do
        ev := drop_row(ev, extend(lp, seq), append(lrow, row_at(s.rrows, seq)))
      s := Stage { ..s, matched = map_delete(lp, s.matched) }
    match key_of(s.lkeys, lrow) of
      Some(k) => s := Stage { ..s, lindex = index_remove(s.lindex, k, lp) }
      None => ()
  for la in sof(d.added) do
    let (lp, lrow) = la
    var found := map_empty
    match key_of(s.lkeys, lrow) of
      Some(k) =>
        s := Stage { ..s, lindex = index_add(s.lindex, k, lp, lrow) }
        for sr in sof(map_to_list(bucket_map(s.rindex, k))) do
          let (seq, rrow) = sr
          let full = append(lrow, rrow)
          if truth(evaluate(s.on, full, [])) then
            found := map_insert(seq, (), found)
            ev := put_row(ev, extend(lp, seq), full)
      None => ()
    if map_size(found) == 0 then
      if s.outer then
        ev := put_row(ev, extend(lp, 0), padded(lrow, s.rwidth))
    else
      s := Stage { ..s, matched = map_insert(lp, found, s.matched) }
  (s, delta_of(ev))

  var best := JNull

fn agg_remove(a : AggState, v : Json, arg : Expr, rows : Map(Pos, Row)) : AggState =
  if is_null(v) then
    a
  elif a.n == 1 then
    agg_empty()
  else
    AggState {
      n = a.n - 1,
      total = a.total - integer(v),
      lo = if compare_value(v, a.lo) == 0 then recompute(arg, rows, true) else a.lo,
      hi = if compare_value(v, a.hi) == 0 then recompute(arg, rows, false) else a.hi
    }

fn agg_apply(v : View, d : Delta) : (View, Delta) =
  var gs := v.groups
  var touched := map_empty
  if not(v.grouped) then
    touched := map_insert("[]", (), touched)
  for pr in sof(d.removed) do
    let (p, row) = pr
    let key = group_key(v, row)
    match map_lookup(key, gs) of
      Some(g) => gs := map_insert(key, group_remove(g, v.aggs, p, row), gs)
      None => ()
    touched := map_insert(key, (), touched)
  for pa in sof(d.added) do
    let (p, row) = pa
    let key = group_key(v, row)
    let g =
      match map_lookup(key, gs) of
        Some(g0) => g0
        None => new_group(v)
    gs := map_insert(key, group_add(g, v.aggs, p, row), gs)
    touched := map_insert(key, (), touched)
  var ev := map_empty
  for key in sof(map_keys(touched)) do
    let g =
      match map_lookup(key, gs) of
        Some(g0) => g0
        None => new_group(v)
    if v.grouped && map_size(g.rows) == 0 then
      gs := map_delete(key, gs)
      ev := retract(ev, g.emitted)
    else
      let new = group_output(v, g)
      if not(same_output(g.emitted, new)) then
        ev := emit(retract(ev, g.emitted), new)
        gs := map_insert(key, GroupState { ..g, emitted = new }, gs)
      elif not(map_member(key, gs)) then
        gs := map_insert(key, g, gs)
  (View { ..v, groups = gs }, delta_of(ev))

fn distinct_apply(v : View, d : Delta) : (View, Delta) =
  var es := v.distinct
  var touched := map_empty
  for pr in sof(d.removed) do
    let (p, row) = pr
    let key = encode(JArr(row))
    match map_lookup(key, es) of
      Some(e) => es := map_insert(key, Entry { ..e, members = map_delete(p, e.members) }, es)
      None => ()
    touched := map_insert(key, (), touched)
  for pa in sof(d.added) do
    let (p, row) = pa
    let key = encode(JArr(row))
    let e =
      match map_lookup(key, es) of
        Some(e0) => e0
        None => Entry { row = row, members = map_empty, emitted = None }
    es := map_insert(key, Entry { ..e, members = map_insert(p, (), e.members) }, es)
    touched := map_insert(key, (), touched)
  var ev := map_empty
  for key in sof(map_keys(touched)) do
    match map_lookup(key, es) of
      Some(e) =>
        let new =
          match map_min(e.members) of
            Some((p, _)) => Some(p)
            None => None
        if new /= e.emitted then
          match e.emitted of
            Some(p) => ev := drop_row(ev, p, e.row)
            None => ()
          match new of
            Some(p) => ev := put_row(ev, p, e.row)
            None => ()
        if map_size(e.members) == 0 then
          es := map_delete(key, es)
        else
          es := map_insert(key, Entry { ..e, emitted = new }, es)
      None => ()
  (View { ..v, distinct = es }, delta_of(ev))

fn downstream(v : View, d : Delta) : View =
  let q = v.plan.query
  let d1 = where_delta(q.predicate, d)
  let (v2, d2) =
    if v.plan.aggregate then
      agg_apply(v, d1)
    else
      (v, project_delta(v.select_t, d1))
  let (v3, d3) =
    if q.distinct then
      distinct_apply(v2, d2)
    else
      (v2, d2)
  result_apply(v3, d3)

fn create_view(plan : Plan, sources : List(Int), loads : List(List((Int, Row)))) : View =
  let q = plan.query
  var offset := 0
  var scans := []
  var stages := []
  for i in srange(0, length(plan.tables)) do
    let width = length(at(plan.tables, i).columns)
    let base = offset
    scans := append(scans, [Scan { offset = base, width = width, filters = map(\(p) -> rebase(p, base), at(plan.filters, i)) }])
    if i > 0 then
      let on = at(q.joins, i - 1)
      let (lk, rk) = equi_keys(on, i, base)
      stages := append(
          stages,
          [Stage {
            on = on,
            outer = at(q.outer, i - 1),
            lkeys = lk,
            rkeys = rk,
            rwidth = width,
            lindex = map_empty,
            rindex = map_empty,
            rrows = map_empty,
            matched = map_empty
          }],
        )
    offset += width
  var aggs := []
  var sels := []
  for s in sof(q.select) do
    let (e, acc) = collect_aggs(fst(s), aggs)
    aggs := acc
    sels := append(sels, [e])
  let (hav, all_aggs) = collect_aggs(q.having, aggs)
  var v := View {
    plan = plan,
    sources = sources,
    scans = scans,
    stages = stages,
    grouped = length(q.groups) > 0,
    aggs = all_aggs,
    select_t = sels,
    having_t = hav,
    groups = map_empty,
    distinct = map_empty,
    result = map_empty
  }
  for i in sof(reverse(range(0, length(loads)))) do
    v := apply_source(v, i, [], at(loads, i))
  -- A global aggregate emits its single row even over empty input.
  downstream(v, empty_delta())
